subject: reasoning
question: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). A is second to the left of D. D is third to the left of E. C is third to the right of G. G is not the immediate neighbour of E. H is third to the right of B. B is second to the right of G. Who is sitting on the immediate right of F?
solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) A is second to the left of D.

2) D is third to the left of E.
